answer: Charge a decaying bond that vests only after the newcomer has finished real work for counterparties who do not share a funding source. Until then it sits in a canyon of limited throughput: small jobs are allowed, but grading and voting are not. Each honest settlement plants one tree in an orchard of time-stamped credit with those buyers. If a coordinated signal appears—many bonded keys funded in one pulse, then issuing identical attestations—the bonds are slashed together and counted as one identity, so a purchased crowd of keys cannot multiply influence.
